Preeclampsia: >20 weeks' gestation;New hypertension: systolic BP ≥ 140 mm Hg or diastolic BP ≥ 90 mm Hg on two occasions
Preeclampsia in Women With CKD: **Hypertension:**;• In women without chronic hypertension: as for preeclampsia;• In women with chronic hypertension: no diagnostic threshold, de novo severe BP (systolic BP > 160 or diastolic BP > 110 mm Hg) or an increase in treatment to maintain BP < 160/110 mm Hg used in research cohorts

Preeclampsia: **Proteinuria:**;• uPCR > 30 mg/mmol (or 0.3 µg/mg);• uACR > 8 mg/mmol (or >800 µg/mg);• > 300 mg/24 h (not indicated if uPCR available);• Dipstick > 2+ (if other methods unavailable);**Serum creatinine:**;• Serum creatinine>1.0 to 1.1 mg/dL (90–100 µmol/L);• Doubling of serum creatinine less than 1.1 mg/dL (100 µmol/L)
Preeclampsia in Women With CKD: **Proteinuria:**;• In women with nonproteinuric CKD: as for preeclampsia;• In women with proteinuric CKD: no diagnostic threshold, > 100% increase and UPCR ≥ 0.3 mg/mg (> 30 mg/mmol) used in research cohorts;**Serum creatinine:**;• In women with CKD and preserved excretory function: as for preeclampsia;• In women with CKD and abnormal prepregnancy function: no consensus on diagnostic threshold for change in creatinine, > 50% increase within 7 days used in research cohorts
